title: 条件付き3連単・回収重視8点の採用検証（精算漏れ修正後）
display_note: 過去の保存予想・締切前オッズ・公式払戻による再検証です。当時公開した8点予想の成績ではありません。
conclusion: 後の日付でも回収率が改善。的中率は低下し、安定した回収率100%超えは未確認。

protocol.selection_source: Development-only diagnostic through 2026-10-16; raw model ranking unchanged.
protocol.validation_limit: One execution after policy freeze. No threshold or rank adjustment from validation outcomes.

methods.flat_100: 100 yen per selected ticket, original 12 versus selected 8, every audited race included
methods.allocation: Existing exact maximin, same saved pre-close quote and identical original 5,000-10,000 yen budget for both, same eligible allocated races

preserve: S/A/B derived from the actual selected-ticket probability mass
unchanged original model, saved forecasts and stake history
adoption_review: chronological validation ROI improvement, not pooled ROI alone
same-race leave-one-out sensitivity for the largest challenger return in each reporting scope
no outcome-based exclusion from the published primary statistic
protocol.sensitivity_rule: For each split and mode, remove exactly the race with greatest challenger payout_yen (earliest race_id breaks ties) from both sides, and recompute. Only a sensitivity analysis, never a selection or eligibility rule.
protocol.retrospective_disclosure: Historical counterfactual selections, not forecasts that were actually published in this 8-ticket form. Validation period aggregate results were previously seen; new policy outcomes were not evaluated before freeze.

corrected_results.method: Same frozen ranks and allocation policy; settlement-only correction adds exactly one formerly pending race. No retuning or outcome-based exclusion.
corrected_results.retrospective_disclosure: Time-ordered retrospective comparison. Aggregate validation outcomes had already been viewed; not a pristine unseen holdout or published eight-ticket betting history.

correction_evidence.reason: Explicit completed official payoff is valid although the decision timestamp remains zero.

original_snapshot_results.method: Policy derived from development, locked before one validation application; no validation tuning.

protocol.objective: Improve official-payout ROI while retaining all races as forecasts, 100-yen unit stakes and 5,000–10,000-yen plans.
eligibility: original plan checksum and amounts valid
original forecast, odds capture and allocation saved strictly before race close
no explicitly cancelled cars or refund/void evidence
valid positive probabilities for every saved ticket
all selected odds finite and positive
protocol.budget: same original budget for every candidate; same eligible races; no ROI-based race exclusion
protocol.validation_disclosure: Aggregate outcomes on 2026-10-19 were observed in previous work. This is pre-specified retrospective chronological validation, not a wholly unseen holdout.

future_confirmation.requirement: Only policy outputs actually saved and published before closing. No historical backfill.

candidates.allocation: For each ticket allocate ceil(B / (100 * quoted_odds)) units, minimum 1. Distribute remaining 100-yen units evenly in original rank order.
Same break-even floor. Distribute remaining units proportional to sqrt(original probability), largest fractional remainder with original-rank tie-break.

candidates.tickets: Use first 8 only if their sum of probabilities is at least 90% of original 12-ticket probability mass. Otherwise original 12.
candidates.allocation: Existing exact maximin allocation, unchanged original budget.

protocol.model_selection: Choose at most one candidate by development ROI alone, subject to hit rate no more than 3 percentage points below baseline; require development ROI strictly above baseline. Do not tune after reading chronological validation. Report all three.
protocol.adoption_gate: Selected candidate must also beat baseline ROI in chronological validation and retain hit rate within 3 pp. Passing supports a prospective comparison only; it is not evidence of guaranteed future ROI above 100%.
forbidden: rewrite original forecasts or stake history

calibration.warning: Same selected, quoted subset only; not an unbiased all-race calibration estimate.

known_limits: 時間順に分けた過去データの再検証。後半の元モデル集計は既に見ており、完全に未見の試験ではありません。
後半だけの配分回収率は62.11%。最大払戻1件を両方式から除くと通算の新8点は91.26%。
均等購入は12点1200円に対し8点800円で、購入総額が違います。配分比較は同じレース・同じ予算です。
締切前のオッズと最終払戻は変動します。保存時に成立した配分でもトリガミになる場合があります。
未精算・返還や着順が不明な記録は両側同条件で除外し、都合のよい的中だけは抽出しません。
